Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
5:29 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 look for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD, and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/Ultra 5 chip. The other things worth checking:

Screen: a sharp 14" or 15.6" panel, at least full HD, and ideally a 16:10 shape so you see more lines of code.
Keyboard: a comfortable one matters more than a graphics card, so skip gaming laptops unless you need them.
Battery and weight: aim for 8+ hours and under 1.7 kg if you carry it daily.
Upgrades: check that the RAM isn't soldered, so you can add more later.

An M-series MacBook Air may also fit the budget if you catch it on offer. Do you want Windows, Mac or Linux? I can then shortlist options.
